Uploading packs with the Pac Builder

Upload a whole pack, review what AutoStacc suggests, publish, and update it later without losing your buyers' files.

On this page

  1. Updating a pack
  2. Sizes

Last updated October 16, 2026

A pack of many files (a ZIP in folders) goes through the Pac Builder: open the product in the Product Studio and choose its Pac Builder section.

  1. Drop a single file, a folder or a whole ZIP. Every file is checked to be what its name says.
  2. Review what AutoStacc suggests for each file (kind, instrument, tempo, key) and keep or change it.
  3. Arrange folders, add a read me and up to three preview clips.
  4. Publish. A clean version goes live at once; one with something flagged waits for AutoStacc's review.

Updating a pack

Upload the new version and it's matched to the live one: unchanged and moved files keep their details, and only changed files are uploaded. Buyers keep files you removed or replaced for 30 days.

Sizes

One file in a Pac can be up to 4 GB. Everything counts against your storage, including replaced files during their 30 days (Storage and limits). A version can sometimes wait for next month's processing allowance; the Pac Builder says so when it does.
